candidates.possible_reason_for_sharing: Several constructors expose a similar symbolic result envelope.
semantic_merge_risks: Tuple, equation, catalog, constraint, invariant, operator, and relation shapes have different normative cardinality and ordering semantics.
candidates.proposed_decision: Evaluate only after at least one additional domain confirms identical semantics; keep local now.

candidates.possible_reason_for_sharing: Multiple features construct fixed source-ordered record collections.
semantic_merge_risks: Node meanings, counts, keys, documentary references, and forbidden operations differ materially.
candidates.proposed_decision: Do not merge until collection semantics and error behavior are proven identical across domains.

candidates.possible_reason_for_sharing: All Principle packages require the same transport-compatible error categories while preserving source identifiers.
semantic_merge_risks: A global mapping could erase feature-specific conditions or conflict with future schema support for authoritative codes.
candidates.proposed_decision: Keep as local mapping pending a global error-contract decision; do not create a shared contract from this domain alone.

candidates.possible_reason_for_sharing: Non-interpretation and explicit unresolved propagation recur throughout the domain.
semantic_merge_risks: Some features have an empty unresolved set, feature 002 has three exact unresolved IDs, and features 006/007 require external providers rather than unresolved-ID propagation.
candidates.proposed_decision: Continue using existing shared opaque and unresolved contracts; no new combined shared contract.
